title_o: Patterns of competence and adjustment among adolescents from authoritative, authoritarian, indulgent, and neglectful families

replications.quote: juvenile offenders who describe their parents as authoritative are more psychosocially mature, more academically competent, less prone to internalized distress, and less prone to externalizing problems than their peers,whereas those who describe their parents as neglectful are less mature, less competent, and more troubled.
